items.problem: After removing the Suspending wiring, the edit left the old OnNavigationFailed + OnSuspending methods stranded after the class closing brace, causing CS8803 (top-level statements must precede declarations), CS0106 ('private' not valid), and CS1022 (end-of-file expected).
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 19 build errors at App.xaml.cs(97/109/117/118); turn 20 view shows duplicated methods after the final '}'; turn 21-22 a follow-up edit deleted the orphans and the build succeeded.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md lines 197-198: 'when you fix a TODO, delete the TODO line entirely in the same edit' and the general expectation that edits leave a well-formed file; this is generic C# editing hygiene, not a UWP API mapping.
items.why_no_skill_change: Leaving stray methods after a class brace is a generic large-hand-edit mistake that a capable model self-corrects on the next build (as it did here on the very next turn); no UWP→WinUI knowledge was missing, so no skill edit would generalize.
